onboarding.copy: Confirmar que los horarios predeterminados se ajustan a los reales. No comenzar con seguimiento compulsivo.

schedule.notes: Morning strength and evening boxing times are preferences, not confirmed. Work 9–10 to 18–19 can conflict with boxing 18:00. In onboarding show overlap warning and let user edit, never assume that schedule is feasible.
schedule.socialDinnerMode: Mark dinner as friends/family per date; do not automatically assign fixed weekdays; can overlap with any day activity except when unwell.

nutrition.objective: Gradual fat loss while preserving muscle and energy; no crash diets

activityEffects.strength: Keep protein; include carbohydrates around training and enough total food.
activityEffects.boxing: Consider digestible carbohydrates before/after class; do not force aggressive reductions.
activityEffects.rest: Keep protein; modest flexibility in carb portions, not automatic large calorie deductions.
activityEffects.busy: Prioritize fast meals and convenience; do not punish missed exercise.
activityEffects.sick: Prioritize hydration, easy-to-tolerate foods, recovery; no forced deficit or training.
activityEffects.social: A flexible meal, no compensatory fasting or excessive cardio afterwards.

whey.use: When useful to meet protein, not mandatory

magnesium.note: Do not automate until dose and clinical advice reviewed

omega3.note: Depends on fatty fish intake and professional advice

interface.socialDinnerMode: Independent dinner override (friends or family), NOT a mutually exclusive day activity; can occur after boxing or strength.
